versions.changelog: Ask for the instance URL on first use and provide a masked local API-key fallback when Control UI is unavailable.
Discover large-file requests and proactively offer Gokapi for large self-directed transfers without automatic upload.
Ask optionally for a download cap; add tested share revocation and clarify verification after expiry or deletion.
Fix URL SecretRef type: env-kind for usable endpoint, protected secret for API key.
Correct URL SecretRef setup so the masked prompt is used only for the actual API key; link public GitHub source.
Initial release: SecretRef-backed Gokapi sharing with explicit retention and chunked-upload guidance.
